title: Enable Devin/Manus automatically when their keys exist
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. A DEVIN_API_KEY or MANUS_API_KEY in the environment or key store enables the agent with its cost guard on; no configure step. Tests zc_cloud_agent_autoenable_*.
